description: Get the full text, author, location and engagement counts of one public post, plus the latest 3 comments as an overview (public posts only). For the full discussion, who replied to whom, or replying to a specific person, use get_post_replies — that is the dedicated comment entry point.

post_id.description: Post id. The 8-character short id from search results is enough; a full id or a post link also works
